notes: The register of third-party art drawn in place of SAM3D's own shapes (simcore/scenery/asset_register.hpp, docs/scenery/ASSETS.md): the map's parts ("parts": the woods', the clutter's and the cards' models, each falling back to our own where its files are absent), and whole aircraft and munitions ("models", "munitions": Sketchfab models under CC-BY, placeholders by the project owner's say-so of 22 Nov 2026, prepared by tools/blender/sketchfab_prepare.py from tools/sketchfab/models.json). Every file lives under /Game/ThirdParty/ (unreal/SAM3D/Content/ThirdParty/) and art/thirdparty/, ignored by git, and is fetched on each machine; a machine without it draws the basic shapes. tools/check_assets.py checks that none is committed.
